mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a sustained decline but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% YoY but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp but S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% YoY but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 2% QoQ but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.
